rulings.bound_value: 3/3 distinct OS SIDs; key material held by 1 principal(s)
rulings.basis: three distinct OS SIDs satisfy native_admission.py:170-171 PRINCIPAL_SEPARATION; PKG_00..08 contain no load-time requirement for per-principal key material; creating checker/maker keys would cost 2 unlocks + a registry re-sign without changing any measured control. Revisit when a checker principal must sign receipts in its own name.

rulings.bound_value: 9/9 PKG volumes declare formal_sourcefreeze: HOLD (DOC-00 L327-330: READABLE_USER_INPUT;NOT_FORMAL_SOURCEFREEZE)
rulings.basis: all nine PKG volumes declare formal_sourcefreeze: HOLD and DOC-00 L327-330 marks the upstream sources READABLE_USER_INPUT;NOT_FORMAL_SOURCEFREEZE, so the missing item is an upstream freeze, not a signature. Signing a source_freeze reference over unfrozen bytes would assert a state that does not exist; the HOLD is therefore declared, measured and left open.

authorizes: D2 do not create checker/maker keys
D3 do not sign a sourcefreeze over unfrozen sources
D5 mission_complete may be computed from these rulings
meaning: a blocking declaration clears only while its bound_value still equals the measured value; any drift voids this ruling and mission_complete returns to false
